name: Ciampino (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ciampino (a yellow bend on blue with stars) within branches, with the inscription CITTA' DI CIAMPINO in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Ciampino, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 21 April 1980.

features.role: Ciampino arms — yellow bend on blue with stars, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTA' DI CIAMPINO arched above the arms
